item.title: Guardiola's return, Man City's defiance - and a game of glorious chaos
item.description: On their return to Etihad Stadium Manchester City put on a show of defiance - even in the face of a PSG masterclass, writes Phil McNulty.

item.title: Jackson steps up again as Aston Villa revival continues
item.description: Nicolas Jackson continues his fine goalscoring form as Aston Villa record an impressive Champions League win.

item.title: Martinez outburst came out of 'anger and frustration'
item.description: Manchester United defender Lisandro Martinez says he "spoke out of anger and frustration" when launching a scathing attack on the club's hierarchy.

item.title: Man City show fight but fall short of fightback against slick PSG
item.description: Defending champions Paris Saint-Germain make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League, after beating Manchester City 4-2 at the Etihad Stadium

item.title: On night of mayhem for Liverpool, Barcola arrives in style
item.description: Bradley Barcola's form was the subject of pre-match questions before Liverpool faced LASK - but the France forward's Champions League hat-trick was the perfect answer.

item.title: Martinez's future at Man Utd in doubt - Thursday's gossip
item.description: Lisandro Martinez's future in doubt at Manchester United, Newcastle's Bazoumana Toure eyed by Manchester United and Arsenal, Getafe interested in free agent Jadon Sancho, plus more.

item.title: Barcola shines as Liverpool score six to beat LASK
item.description: Bradley Barcola scores a hat-trick as Liverpool beat LASK 6-3 in Austria to make it two wins from two in the league phase of this season's Champions League.

item.title: 'Shameless' - Mourinho critical of Vinicius Jr ban timing
item.description: Real Madrid forward Vinicius Jr will miss El Clasico against Barcelona after being given a four-game ban.

item.title: Wilcox the target again in another damaging Man Utd fallout
item.description: Lisandro Martinez's explosive comments after Manchester United's Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid turn the spotlight back on director of football Jason Wilcox.

item.title: PSG on 'different level' - are they building greatest European dynasty?
item.description: Paris St-Germain are eyeing a third successive Champions League crown after dismantling Manchester City, but where do they rank against Europe's most dominant clubs?

item.title: Villa rewrite the record books as they hit Fenerbahce for six
item.description: Aston Villa record their biggest ever win in a European competition as they thrash Turkish side Fenerbahce 6-0 at Villa Park, with Nicolas Jackson and Ross Barkley both scoring twice.

item.title: Real Madrid stun Roma after dramatic late comeback
item.description: Real Madrid complete their latest dramatic Champions League comeback by scoring three goals in the final seven minutes to earn manager Jose Mourinho a win on his return to Roma.

item.title: Brilliant Barcola scores first hat-trick to get lift-off at Liverpool
item.description: Liverpool's summer signing Bradley Barcola scores his first senior hat-trick, and his first goals for Liverpool, as he helps his side beat LASK 6-3 in Austria to make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League.

item.title: Yoro sent off as Man Utd stumble to defeat against Atletico Madrid
item.description: Manchester United's winless run stretches to five matches, as they're beaten 2-0 by Atletico Madrid in the Champions League, in a match which saw them concede in the opening minute before ending the game with ten men after Leny Yoro was sent off.

item.title: 'Players won't like it' - Martinez apologises, but is the damage done?
item.description: Champions League Match of the Day pundits Nedum Onuoha, Stephen Warnock, and Rory Smith analyse Lisandro Martinez's comments following Manchester United's 2-0 loss to Atletico Madrid and the impact they'll have on the club.

item.title: Substitutes steal the show as Arsenal score three against Lille
item.description: Substitute Bukayo Saka scores one and sets up another to help Arsenal beat Lille 3-0 at the Emirates, as the Premier League champions made it two wins from two in the Champions League.

item.title: Viking snatch draw against Bayern Munich in six-goal thriller
item.description: Norwegian champions Viking score a 90th minute equaliser to snatch a 3-3 draw against six-time European champions Bayern Munich in the Champions League, securing one of the biggest results in the club's history.

item.title: Gordon scores as 'brilliant Barcelona' thrash Galatasaray
item.description: Anthony Gordon scores his first Champions League goal for Barcelona as the Spanish side come from behind to thrash Galatasaray 4-1 in Istanbul, and make it two wins from two in this season's Champions League.

item.title: Tresoldi hat-trick fires Club Brugge to victory over Inter in seven-goal thriller
item.description: Club Brugge's Nicolo Tresoldi scores a hat-trick as the Belgian side edge Inter Milan 4-3, extending Inter's Champions League losing run to four matches for the first time in their history.

item.title: Bodo/Glimt impress in win over Dortmund
item.description: Bodo/Glimt bounce back from their thrashing at Bayern with a fine 1-0 win in the Champions League over Borussia Dortmund.

item.title: Isco snatches late Betis win as they edge past Porto
item.description: Isco scores an 84th minute penalty to help Real Betis snatch a late 3-2 win against Porto, giving them back to back wins at the start of this season's Champions League.

item.title: Feyenoord come from behind to beat Como
item.description: Feyenoord come from a goal to beat Como 3-2 in Rotterdam to secure their first win of the league phase in this season's Champions League.

item.title: Millwall's Neil criticised over racial abuse stoppage comments
